
===== docker-compose.yml
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB}
    ports:
      - '5432:5432'
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    command: ['redis-server', '--appendonly', 'yes', '--maxmemory-policy', 'noeviction']
    ports:
      - '6379:6379'
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'redis-cli', 'ping']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

volumes:
  postgres_data:
  redis_data:

===== apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma
generator client {
  provider            = "prisma-client"
  output              = "../src/generated/prisma"
  moduleFormat        = "esm"
  importFileExtension = "js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
}

// ---------- Enums ----------

enum UserRole {
  CUSTOMER
  STAFF
  ADMIN
}

enum OrderStatus {
  PENDING
  ACCEPTED
  REJECTED
  PREPARING
  READY
  COMPLETED
  CANCELLED
}

enum PaymentMethod {
  PAY_ON_COLLECTION
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  UNPAID
  PAID
}

enum OrderChangeSource {
  CUSTOMER
  STAFF
  SYSTEM
}

enum OrderReasonCode {
  CUSTOMER_REQUEST
  ITEM_UNAVAILABLE
  KITCHEN_BUSY
  RESTAURANT_CLOSING
  ACCEPTANCE_TIMEOUT
  OTHER
}

// ---------- Users & auth ----------

model User {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  name            String   @db.VarChar(100)
  email           String   @db.VarChar(255)
  emailNormalized String   @unique @map("email_normalized") @db.VarChar(255)
  passwordHash    String   @map("password_hash")
  role            UserRole @default(CUSTOMER)
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  orders        Order[]
  refreshTokens RefreshToken[]
  statusChanges OrderStatusHistory[]

  @@map("users")
}

model RefreshToken {
  id                String    @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  userId            String    @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  tokenHash         String    @unique @map("token_hash") @db.VarChar(255)
  expiresAt         DateTime  @map("expires_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  revokedAt         DateTime? @map("revoked_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  replacedByTokenId String?   @unique @map("replaced_by_token_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt         DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  user       User          @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  replacedBy RefreshToken? @relation("TokenRotation", fields: [replacedByTokenId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  replaces   RefreshToken? @relation("TokenRotation")

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("refresh_tokens")
}

// ---------- Menu ----------

model Category {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  name           String   @db.VarChar(100)
  nameNormalized String   @unique @map("name_normalized") @db.VarChar(100)
  description    String?  @db.VarChar(500)
  isActive       Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  menuItems MenuItem[]

  @@map("categories")
}

model MenuItem {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  categoryId  String   @map("category_id") @db.Uuid
  name        String   @db.VarChar(100)
  description String?  @db.VarChar(500)
  price       Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  imageUrl    String?  @map("image_url") @db.VarChar(2048)
  isAvailable Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_available")
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  category   Category    @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  orderItems OrderItem[]

  @@index([categoryId])
  @@map("menu_items")
}

// ---------- Orders ----------

model Order {
  id                 String        @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  customerId         String        @map("customer_id") @db.Uuid
  status             OrderStatus   @default(PENDING)
  paymentMethod      PaymentMethod @default(PAY_ON_COLLECTION) @map("payment_method")
  paymentStatus      PaymentStatus @default(UNPAID) @map("payment_status")
  subtotal           Decimal       @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  notes              String?       @db.VarChar(300)
  acceptanceDeadline DateTime      @map("acceptance_deadline") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  idempotencyKey     String        @map("idempotency_key") @db.Uuid
  createdAt          DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updatedAt          DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  customer      User                 @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  items         OrderItem[]
  statusHistory OrderStatusHistory[]

  @@unique([customerId, idempotencyKey])
  @@index([customerId, createdAt(sort: Desc)])
  @@index([status, createdAt])
  @@index([status, acceptanceDeadline])
  @@map("orders")
}

model OrderItem {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  orderId    String   @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  menuItemId String   @map("menu_item_id") @db.Uuid
  itemName   String   @map("item_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  unitPrice  Decimal  @map("unit_price") @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  quantity   Int
  lineTotal  Decimal  @map("line_total") @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  order    Order    @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  menuItem MenuItem @relation(fields: [menuItemId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@index([orderId])
  @@index([menuItemId])
  @@map("order_items")
}

model OrderStatusHistory {
  id             String            @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  orderId        String            @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  previousStatus OrderStatus?      @map("previous_status")
  newStatus      OrderStatus       @map("new_status")
  changedById    String?           @map("changed_by_id") @db.Uuid
  changeSource   OrderChangeSource @map("change_source")
  reasonCode     OrderReasonCode?  @map("reason_code")
  reasonNote     String?           @map("reason_note") @db.VarChar(300)
  changedAt      DateTime          @default(now()) @map("changed_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  order     Order @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  changedBy User? @relation(fields: [changedById], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@index([orderId, changedAt])
  @@map("order_status_history")
}

===== D:\My Projects\food-ordering-platform\apps\api\src\config\env.ts
import { z } from 'zod';

const envSchema = z.object({
  NODE_ENV: z.enum(['development', 'test', 'production']).default('development'),
  PORT: z.coerce.number().int().positive().default(4000),
  DATABASE_URL: z.url(),
  REDIS_URL: z.url(),
  JWT_ACCESS_SECRET: z.string().min(32),
  CORS_ORIGIN: z.url().default('http://localhost:5173'),
  LOG_LEVEL: z.enum(['fatal', 'error', 'warn', 'info', 'debug', 'trace', 'silent']).default('info'),
  BCRYPT_ROUNDS: z.coerce.number().int().min(4).max(15).default(12),
  // Login/register attempts per IP per minute. Raise it locally for the E2E tests.
  AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE: z.coerce.number().int().positive().default(5),
  ORDER_ACCEPTANCE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: z.coerce.number().int().positive().default(15),
  MINIMUM_ORDER_AMOUNT: z
    .string()
    .regex(/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/)
    .default('500.00'),
});

const parsed = envSchema.safeParse(process.env);

if (!parsed.success) {
  console.error('❌ Invalid environment variables:\n' + z.prettifyError(parsed.error));
  process.exit(1);
}

export const env = parsed.data;
export type Env = typeof env;

async function decodeBase64AsWasm(wasmBase64: string): Promise<WebAssembly.Module> {
  const { Buffer } = await import('node:buffer')
  const wasmArray = Buffer.from(wasmBase64, 'base64')
  return new WebAssembly.Module(wasmArray)
}

   *   { emit: 'event', level: 'warn' }
   *   { emit: 'event', level: 'error' }

   * 
   * / Emit as events and log to stdout
   * og: [
   *  { emit: 'stdout', level: 'query' },
   *  { emit: 'stdout', level: 'info' },
   *  { emit: 'stdout', level: 'warn' }
   *  { emit: 'stdout', level: 'error' }
   * 
   * ```
   * Read more in our [docs](https://pris.ly/d/logging).

  log?: (LogLevel | LogDefinition)[]

  transactionOptions?: {

   *     traceContext(),

   * ```
   */
  comments?: runtime.SqlCommenterPlugin[]
  /**
   * Optional maximum size for the query plan cache. If not provided, a default size will be used.
   * A value of `0` can be used to disable the cache entirely. A higher cache size can improve
   * performance for applications that execute a large number of unique queries, while a smaller

  /**
   * A driver adapter that PrismaClient uses to connect to your database, such as the ones provided by `@prisma/adapter-pg`, `@prisma/adapter-libsql`, `@prisma/adapter-planetscale`, etc.

   * Learn more: https://pris.ly/d/driver-adapters

   * @example
   * ```ts
   * import { PrismaPg } from '@prisma/adapter-pg'
   * import { PrismaClient } from './generated/prisma/client'
   * 
   * const adapter = new PrismaPg({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL })
   * const prisma = new PrismaClient({ adapter })
   * ```

  adapter: runtime.SqlDriverAdapterFactory

}

/**

export type LogLevel = 'info' | 'query' | 'warn' | 'error'
export type LogDefinition = {
  level: LogLevel
  emit: 'stdout' | 'event'
}

export type CheckIsLogLevel<T> = T extends LogLevel ? T : never;

export type GetLogType<T> = CheckIsLogLevel<
  T extends LogDefinition ? T['level'] : T
>;

export type GetEvents<T extends any[]> = T extends Array<LogLevel | LogDefinition>
  ? GetLogType<T[number]>
  : never;

export type QueryEvent = {
  timestamp: Date
  query: string

}

export type LogEvent = {
  timestamp: Date
  message: string

}
